d.t: Blended Polyolefin Macro/Micro – synthetic fibres designed to enhance the distribution and performance of fibre reinforcement
d.s: SikaFiber PPM 48/19 is a blend of Macro Structural Synthetic Fibres and Micro Monofilament Fibres which are designed to an optimum gradation. This engineered combination of macro/micro fibres provides improved interfacial bonding and flexural toughness efficiency.
a: Requires no minimum amount of concrete cover
It is always placed in compliance with the codes
Safer and easier than traditional reinforcement
SikaFiber PPM 48/19 concrete can be pumped, sprayed or placed using conventional equipment.
us: Control and reduce plastic shrinkage cracking
d.pk: SikaFiber PPM 48/19 is packed in 2.3kg boxes consisting of 2kg of macro fibre component and a biodegradable bag with 0.3kg of micro fibre. Each box is designed for fast dispersion within the concrete mix. SikaFiber PPM 48/19 can be packed on pallets or most other combinations if required.

sec.t: Macro fibre complies with EN 14489-2 Class 2 and micro with Class 1a. SikaFiber PPM 48/19 meets the requirements of ASTM C1116 Type III.
SikaFiber PPM 48/19 is compatible with all Sika Concrete admixtures and additives.
The typical dose rate for SikaFiber PPM 48/19 is 2.3 kg per m3. Higher dose rates up 6.9 kg per m3 can be used as the performance requirements dictate.
